name: Dreams And Visions
overview: Scripture reveals that God communicates with His people through dreams and visions, using these means to make Himself known and to impart understanding, as seen in Numbers 12:6 and Daniel 1:17. These supernatural experiences are not random but purposeful, often accompanying prophetic revelation and divine instruction, highlighted by Joel 2:28 and Acts 2:17, where the outpouring of the Spirit results in dreams and visions across all ages. Furthermore, Proverbs 29:18 emphasizes the vital role of vision for spiritual vitality and obedience to God's law, while Job 33:15 acknowledges the mysterious way God speaks in the quiet moments of sleep.
